rule: Fill-path only, mapped by sheet geometry: each join targets the fillable cell whose printed caption (from the frozen page text layer) names the item. Text and TIN combs: caption left of or above the comb, or the header over the column. Amounts: the peso comb plus the 2-slot centavo comb directly right of it form one money_joins pair. Booleans and radios: X in the box immediately left of the printed option; the first printed option of a pair takes _1. Schedule 1 rows 13-14 rate boxes, the Schedule 2/3 row-3 lines, and the Part III/tax agent blocks have no safe key and stay blank. Since #113: the item 9 second line, Item 13A, the Schedule 1 items 13-14 BSP exchange rate (peso+2-slot comb) and the page 2/3 TIN headers print too (derived: keys from Form1602QDraft::to_print_field_map); every other value has a reviewed not_joined reason. One writer key may fill several cells (html_ids).
